title: Fix Image Cover Anchor Mechanism
description: The image-fit=cover mechanism in print/tex/semio-window.sty always center-crops (hard-coded symmetric trim), ignoring the window's anchor. Fix it to behave like CSS object-fit:cover + object-position: scale the image without distortion to fully cover the target box, then crop overflow according to anchor (nw..se). Also switch the appendix Photo windows in mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/anhang/projekte.tex from image-fit=contain to image-fit=cover (they currently letterbox instead of covering), while ensuring the cover path is safe inside fixed-height WindowItems (avoid the documented tcolorbox double-typeset bug) by making cover width-only sized instead of height-sized.
summary:
Fixed image-fit=cover to behave like CSS object-fit:cover + object-position instead of always center-cropping. In print/tex/semio-window.sty, \semio_image_typeset_cover:n now scales to one dimension into a dedicated savebox (\semio@image@cover@box) and TikZ-clips the target window out of it at an offset driven by the window's anchor (halign for horizontal overflow, valign for vertical), via new helper \semio_image_cover_offset_distribute:nnn. This replaced the old hard-coded symmetric-trim \includegraphics[trim=,clip=true] approach, which also turned out to silently double-paint the image with this driver (confirmed via an independent PDFKit render) — the rewrite avoids trim=/clip=true entirely. Removed now-dead code: \semio_image_nat_measure:n, \semio@image@measure, the old \l_semio_image_trim_*_dim / nat_*_dim variables, and the old \semio@image@graphics@cover@h/@w macros.

Extended print/template/report/report.content.tex with cover anchor demos (nw/se/w/e, both hcrop and vcrop branches) and an in-item WindowArrangement checkpoint, verified via `bun ./📜️script.ts build report`.

Switched all 67 appendix Photo windows in mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/anhang/projekte.tex from image-fit=contain to image-fit=cover, anchor=center, so the Projekte Katalog photos fill their 0.3-width WindowItem columns instead of being letterboxed. Verified via `bun ./📜️script.ts build` in mit-bestand/bericht — appendix photos now cover their slots correctly, no layout/overfull-vbox regressions.

KNOWN UNRESOLVED ISSUE (pre-existing, not introduced by this work, documented in a code comment at the cover implementation): any cover image narrower than its window — which includes every appendix photo now — renders with a faint duplicate/ghost copy of the image bleeding past the crop edge. Reproduced with the original trim+clip code, the new TikZ-clip rewrite, and even the shipped contain-mode itemclip path when its overflow-clip condition is exercised (which had apparently never been tested before). Confirmed via an independent PDFKit render (rules out a poppler/pdftoppm artifact) and a single-pass reruns=0 compile (rules out aux-file/rerun state accumulation); isolated minimal tikz+savebox+image reproductions outside any window do NOT show it, only inside this package's tcolorbox windows (enhanced + custom overlays), regardless of breakable. Root cause not found — needs dedicated follow-up investigation into the tcolorbox/enhanced-box interaction. Dev explicitly chose to ship the anchor-cropping fix and the appendix cover rollout anyway (properly covering + subtle ghosting beats letterboxing).
